verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's evidence covers corporation and LLC formation, a generic library of '150+ customizable legal documents', and attorney consultations. Nothing in the pack mentions founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment agreements, or 83(b) election filing. A generic document library and attorney consults are adjacent offerings, not documented support for this post-incorporation workflow, so no credit is earned.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork
